title: The batch runner merges only the commit CI ran on
why: A merge go with no head can land a commit CI never ran on; #2274 makes the auto-mode entry "Batch Runner Merge" allow only `merge <pr> --confirm --head <sha>`.
note: PR #2274 (head 289711ca7), round 3 passed. Blocked on owner page item 461 (runner-merge-needs-head): a settings.json change needs the owner's word. It narrows the entry. On a yes, #2274 joins batch 69. Filed from the coordinator, 04:28 CST Nov 9. Owner pick on the waiting page (13:09 CST Nov 9): item 461 a. The settings change in #2274 is allowed as written: the batch runner merges only the commit CI ran on. #2274 joins a batch.
